name: Starbucks Turnaround Strategy
about: A consultancy report examining Starbucks' operational and financial challenges amid its "Back to Starbucks" turnaround strategy. Analysed financial statements, analyst reports and press disclosures, applying the Turnaround Strategy Lifecycle and the Cost–Quality Tradeoff Framework, with stakeholder analysis across leadership, store managers, investors and customers. Delivered seven evidence-based recommendations spanning flexible workforce management, phased pilot testing, technology-enabled productivity, centralised cost governance, and portfolio rationalisation.
statLabel: North American operating margin decline diagnosed year-on-year

name: AgriPulse CropFusion
about: A technical consultancy report designing a cloud-based big data architecture for a global agricultural IoT platform. Evaluated requirements across the 4 V's framework and compared AWS, Azure and Google Cloud on scalability, real-time processing, cost and compliance. Proposed a full Azure architecture from data ingestion to business intelligence, with a structured risk assessment covering security, cost escalation, data integrity and vendor lock-in — mitigated through end-to-end encryption, RBAC, lifecycle cost policies and multi-region failover.
statLabel: farmers served by the proposed IoT data platform

name: KRONIK Financial Services
about: Designed and documented a Python-based data pipeline to automate loan application processing for a financial services firm. The solution addressed data quality challenges across PDF and Excel datasets — missing values, duplicates and inconsistencies — structured with the CRISP-DM framework. Performed EDA to surface key approval patterns and recommended predictive modelling approaches including Logistic Regression, Random Forest and XGBoost, with version control via Git and pseudocode design for cross-team maintainability.
statLabel: growth in loan application volumes the pipeline was built to absorb

name: Aphrodite Beauty Ltd.
about: A full data analytics project for a beauty company operating across Austria, the Netherlands and Portugal. Cleaned and prepared a multi-year sales dataset in Excel, resolving missing values, duplicate records and formatting errors with COUNTBLANK formulas and conditional formatting. Performed exploratory and trend analysis across monthly revenue, product categories and country-level benchmarks, assessed the impact of private label manufacturing contracts, and delivered strategic KPI recommendations to guide market expansion.
statLabel: benchmarked across Austria, the Netherlands and Portugal, 2021–2023
